rationale: The verified abstract describes recurrent autumnal hallucinations after reported belladonna poisoning. Prior review verified the plant identity as distinct from fig. The complete original pages are still needed for the exact fig comparison.

The longitudinal Parkinson cohort measures disease-associated transcription in blood and considers RNA-based biomarkers. Fresh culinary sage and a dystonia change after consumption are outside its comparisons.
A rat feeding-to-satiety experiment measures brain dopamine during standard feeding. Egg cartons are enrichment objects; no egg is assigned as food and no clinical fall count is recorded.
Worm egg laying is a developmental synchronization step in a TDP-43 model. The study measures laboratory neurotoxicity and contains no edible egg comparison or Parkinson falls endpoint.
The paper reviews genome editing in neurological disease. The fertilized egg reference is an example of germline biology. It supplies no food intervention or fall-frequency comparison.

A parkinsonism cohort uses the same 320-kcal radiolabeled egg meal during standardized gastric-emptying scintigraphy. Egg is a genuine ingested clinical test exposure. The article provides no assigned poached-egg contrast or fall-frequency outcome.
This Parkinson case describes management during severe pneumonia and continuation of dopaminergic therapy. It contains no culinary ground sage exposure or sage-attributed rigidity outcome.

The original compares induction and differentiation protocols for human induced pluripotent stem cells in neural tissue engineering. It contains no oral ground sage comparison or human muscle-rigidity outcome.

The original abstract compares dementia rating-scale profiles across diagnosed neurodegenerative groups. It supplies no grilled salmon assignment or exposure-linked visual hallucination frequency. Full methods and tables remain to be checked.

The retained original abstract compares memory and executive functions in Parkinson dementia and Alzheimer disease. There is no item describing grilled salmon or an attributable bradykinesia contrast at this depth.

The original abstract differentiates kinds of implicit memory across Parkinson, Huntington and Alzheimer groups. It provides no salmon exposure, preparation or bradykinesia change. The original printed pages remain open.

The verified clinical abstract concerns cognitive symptoms and evidence for a cortical variant of multiple sclerosis. Poached salmon and a diagnosed Parkinson anxiety comparison are absent from the available description.

The measured exposure is an experimental visual distraction condition during a study of depression. The clinical and electrophysiological findings supply no culinary salmon intervention or Parkinson-specific anxiety result.

Brain-region gene expression is compared in experimental mice. The salmon reference is laboratory reagent terminology involving salmon sperm DNA. The source does not compare consumption of poached salmon.
This prodromal synucleinopathy protocol includes mood and other phenotyping. Salmon describes a hue in a color test. No culinary salmon intervention is included.

The author abstract describes conditioned eyeblink learning and regional brain metabolism measured with PET. The available material gives no quantified salmon exposure or Parkinson anxiety outcome. The original text and figures remain open.
The abstract describes motor responsiveness to apomorphine and levodopa in asymmetric Parkinson disease. There is no poached-salmon contrast or clinical anxiety estimate at the current access depth.

The abstract evaluates cognition in Huntington disease gene carriers. Its available design and results provide no culinary salmon contrast or Parkinson anxiety estimate. The original report remains open.
The indexed abstract concerns familial extrapyramidal symptoms with peripheral neuropathy. It supplies no measured raw-onion exposure or Parkinson rigidity estimate.

The verified title and citation identify a neuromuscular junction finding after carbendazim intoxication. The NLM entry supplies no author abstract or baked turkey comparison. The full published case remains open.

The original abstract concerns Alaska Native mortality and cause-of-death categories. The existing indexed note supplies the exact public route. It gives no ground-sage exposure or dietary Parkinson fall estimate.
The full paper compares gene-expression profiles of nematodes. SAGE denotes serial analysis of gene expression. Ground culinary sage and human fall frequency are outside the experiment.

The indexed abstract describes an open cholinesterase-inhibitor study in vascular dementia. The existing publisher and PMC PDF access note does not establish culinary ground sage or a Parkinson fall-frequency estimate.
The indexed abstract describes quetiapine use and behavior in Lewy body disease. It has no ground sage comparison or Parkinson fall-frequency result. The original article PDF remains open.
The article describes nursing and care experiences for two older residents. There is no ground sage comparison and no attributable Parkinson fall outcome.
The observational study examines word priming and progression of parkinsonian signs in aging. GRAPE is a word-stem task response, without consumption or a food-linked rigidity estimate.

The original movement-disorder case concerns neurological symptoms following encephalitis. Grapes occur in the occupational history. The study supplies no frozen-grape exposure or comparative muscle rigidity outcome.
The family case series describes dysarthria and stuttering in late-onset Tay-Sachs disease. Cherry-red describes a retinal sign cited in the background. Dried cherry is outside the exposure history.
PARKinSOUND investigates structured orchestra participation in Parkinson disease. The intervention is musical practice. No ground-sage comparison or culinary effect on stride is measured.
